idea: Diagonal two-big-square family: place squares of sides a and 1−a in opposite corners, and fill the two off-diagonal a×(1−a) rectangles with the best rectangle-table packings using counts n1 and n2. Optimise a over rationals and also allow each big square to be subdivided into a j×j grid. This is a closed-form non-grid family that is cheap to enumerate.
